name: @kithena/auth-shell

scripts.deploy: pnpm run build:packages && MODERNJS_DEPLOY=vercel modern deploy

//typescript: TypeScript 6, not the repo's 7. Modern.js compiles server/ with the TypeScript programmatic API via TypescriptLoader({ appDirectory }), which resolves from here — and 7.0 ships no programmatic API, so ts.sys is undefined and the build dies in getFormatHost. This package therefore typechecks on 6 as well, which is the merge gate anyway.
//deploy: Deployed as Vercel Functions, not a static site: this app has a Custom Web Server and SSR, which Modern.js's guide says must go to Functions. MODERNJS_DEPLOY is set explicitly rather than left to platform detection — without it `modern deploy` emits the Node.js server output and prints 'preview this build by node .output/index', which Vercel cannot serve. Being explicit also means this command produces the same artifact locally as it does on Vercel.
